sections.label: Book 35
sections.name: Funeral formulas: the sacrifice to the Fathers

verses.sa: अपेतो यन्तु पणयोऽसुम्ना देवपीयवः। अस्य लोकः सुतावतः। द्युभिरहोभिरक्तुभिर्व्यक्तं यमो ददात्ववसानमस्मै॥
verses.tr: apeto yantu paṇayo'sumnā devapīyavaḥ asya lokaḥ sutāvataḥ dyubhirahobhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātvavasānamasmai
verses.en: Begone the Ahis, hence away, rebellious, ncohiera of the Gods! The place is his Who poured the juice.

verses.sa: सविता ते शरीरेभ्यः पृथिव्याँल्लोकमिच्छतु। तस्मै युज्यन्तामुस्रियाः॥
verses.tr: savitā te śarīrebhyaḥ pṛthivyāṃllokamicchatu tasmai yujyantāmusriyāḥ
verses.en: Let Savitar approve a spot upon the earth for thy remains: And let the bulls be yoked for it.

verses.sa: वायुः पुनातु सविता पुनात्वग्नेर्भ्राजसा सूर्यस्य वर्चसा। वि मुच्यन्तामुस्रियाः॥
verses.tr: vāyuḥ punātu savitā punātvagnerbhrājasā sūryasya varcasā vi mucyantāmusriyāḥ
verses.en: Let Vayu purify. Let Savitar purify. With Agni's glitter. With Savitar's lustre. Let the bulls be unyoked.

verses.sa: अश्वत्थे वो निषदनं पर्णे वो वसतिष्कृता। गोभाज इत्किलासथ यत्सनवथ पूरुषम्॥
verses.tr: aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam
verses.en: The Holy Fig Tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna Tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sa: सविता ते शरीराणि मातुरुपस्थ आ वपतु। तस्मै पृथिवि शं भव॥
verses.tr: savitā te śarīrāṇi māturupastha ā vapatu tasmai pṛthivi śaṃ bhava
verses.en: Let Savitar lay down thy bones committed to the Mother's lap. Be pleasant to this man, O Earth.

verses.sa: प्रजापतौ त्वा देवतायामुपोदके लोके नि दधाम्यसौ। अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: prajāpatau tvā devatāyāmupodake loke ni dadhāmyasau apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Here in the God Prajapati, near water, Man, I lay thee down: May his light drive mishap from us.

verses.sa: परं मृत्यो अनु परेहि पन्थां यस्ते अन्य इतरो देवयानात्। चक्षुष्मते शृण्वते ते ब्रवीमि मा नः प्रजां रीरिषो मोत वीरान्॥
verses.tr: paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste anya itaro devayānāt cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān
verses.en: Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel. To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our offspring, injure not our heroes.

verses.sa: शं वातः शं हि ते घृणिः शं ते भवन्त्विष्टकाः। शं ते भवन्त्वग्नयः पार्थिवासो मा त्वाऽभि शूशुचन्॥
verses.tr: śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ hi te ghṛṇiḥ śaṃ te bhavantviṣṭakāḥ śaṃ te bhavantvagnayaḥ pārthivāso mā tvā'bhi śūśucan
verses.en: Pleasant to thee be wind and sun, and pleasant be the bricks to thee. Pleasant to thee be the terrestrial fires: let them not scorch thee in their flames.

verses.sa: कल्पन्तां ते दिशस्तुभ्यमापः शिवतमास्तुभ्यं भवन्तु सिन्धवः। अन्तरिक्षं शिवं तुभ्यं कल्पन्तां ते दिशः सर्वाः॥
verses.tr: kalpantāṃ te diśastubhyamāpaḥ śivatamāstubhyaṃ bhavantu sindhavaḥ antarikṣaṃ śivaṃ tubhyaṃ kalpantāṃ te diśaḥ sarvāḥ
verses.en: Prosper for thee the regions and the waters, and let the seas for thee be most propitious. Auspicious unto thee be Air. Prosper all Quarters well for thee!

verses.sa: अश्मन्वती रीयते सं रभध्वमुत्तिष्ठत प्र तरता सखायः। अत्रा जहीमोऽशिवा ये असञ्छिवान्वयमुत्तरेमाभि वाजान्॥
verses.tr: aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ atrā jahīmo'śivā ye asañchivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān
verses.en: On flows the stony flood: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, my friends, and pass the river. Here let us leave the powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.

verses.sa: अपाघमप किल्विषमप कृत्यामपो रपः। अपामार्ग त्वमस्मदप दुःष्वप्न्यं सुव॥
verses.tr: apāghamapa kilviṣamapa kṛtyāmapo rapaḥ apāmārga tvamasmadapa duḥṣvapnyaṃ suva
verses.en: Drive away evil, drive away fault, sorcery, and guiltiness. Do thou, O Apkmirga, drive the evil dream away from us.

verses.sa: सुमित्रिया न आप ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: To us let waters and the plants be friendly, to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sa: अनड्वाहमन्वारभामहे सौरभेयं स्वस्तये। स न इन्द्र इव देवेभ्यो वह्निः सन्तारणो भव॥
verses.tr: anaḍvāhamanvārabhāmahe saurabheyaṃ svastaye sa na indra iva devebhyo vahniḥ santāraṇo bhava
verses.en: For our prosperity we touch the ox the son of Surfibhi. Be bearer and deliverer to us as Indra to the Gods.

verses.sa: उद्वयं तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्त उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: Looking upon the loftiest light, etc., as in XX. 21.

verses.sa: इमं जीवेभ्यः परिधिं दधामि मैषां नु गादपरो अर्थमेतम्। शतं जीवन्तु शरदः पुरूचीरन्तर्मृत्युं दधतां पर्वतेन॥
verses.tr: imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīrantarmṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena
verses.en: Here I erect this rampart for the living: let none of these, none other, reach this limit. May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain. IG

verses.sa: अग्न आयूंषि पवस्व आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः। आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्॥
verses.tr: agna āyūṃṣi pavasva ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ āre bādhasva ducchunām
verses.en: Agni, thou pourest life, etc., as in XIX. 38.

verses.sa: आयुष्मानग्ने हविषा वृधानो घृतप्रतीको घृतयोनिरेधि। घृतं पीत्वा मधु चारु गव्यं पितेव पुत्रमभि रक्षतादिमान्त्स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: āyuṣmānagne haviṣā vṛdhāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniredhi ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putramabhi rakṣatādimāntsvāhā
verses.en: Waxing with sacrifice live long, O Agni, with butter on thy face and homed in fatness. When thou hast drunk the cows fair savoury butter, guard, as a father guards his son, these people.

verses.sa: परीमे गामनेषत पर्यग्निमहृषत। देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमाँ२ आ दधर्षति॥
verses.tr: parīme gāmaneṣata paryagnimahṛṣata deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imāṃ2 ā dadharṣati
verses.en: These men have led about the ox, have duly, carried Agni round, And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

verses.sa: क्रव्यादमग्निं प्र हिणोमि दूरं यमराज्यं गच्छतु रिप्रवाहः। इहैवायमितरो जातवेदा देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहतु प्रजानन्॥
verses.tr: kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājyaṃ gacchatu ripravāhaḥ ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
verses.en: I drive Corpse-eating Agni to a distance: sin-laden let him go to Yama's kingdom. Here let this other, Jatavedas, carry oblation to the Deities, foreknowing.

verses.sa: वह वपां जातवेदः पितृभ्यो यत्रैनान्वेत्थ निहितान् पराके। मेदसः कुल्या उप तान्त्स्रवन्तु सत्या एषामाशिषः सं नमन्तां स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatrainānvettha nihitān parāke medasaḥ kulyā upa tāntsravantu satyā eṣāmāśiṣaḥ saṃ namantāṃ svāhā
verses.en: Carry the fat to Fathers, Jatavedas, where, far away, thou knowest them established. Let rivulets of marrow flow to meet them, and let their truthful wishes be accomplished. All-hail!

verses.sa: स्योना पृथिवि नो भवानृक्षरा निवेशनी। यच्छा नः शर्म सप्रथाः। अप नः शोशुचदघम्॥
verses.tr: syonā pṛthivi no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ apa naḥ śośucadagham
verses.en: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, without a thorn, our rest' ing-place. Vouchsafe us shelter reaching far. May thy light drive mishap from us.

verses.sa: अस्मात्त्वमधि जातोऽसि त्वदयं जायतां पुनः। असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: asmāttvamadhi jāto'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ asau svargāya lokāya svāhā
verses.en: Born art thou, Agni, from this man: let him again be born from thee, For Svarga's world, the man I name. All-hail!
